summary: @servicetitan/eslint-plugin-mobx-6 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (or reuses a locally-installed `bun`) and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`, a ~727KB single-line obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, shuffled string-array rotator `WV8StW` over a numeric-constant table `n7gIxM`, mangled identifiers such as `MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `JqTtnbZ`). The advertised purpose of the package is an ESLint plugin for MobX 6 lint rules (`dist/index.js`); an ESLint plugin does not require a second language runtime or a 727KB opaque payload to configure lint rules. The choice of an alternate runtime for the payload places the executed code outside the inspection surface of Node-based tooling, and the obfuscation prevents static verification of the payload's network and filesystem behavior. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: install-time fetch of a runtime whose only purpose is to execute an opaque sibling bundle unrelated to the package's stated function.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
